svg.title: @historyslides video pipeline
svg.desc: @historyslides video pipeline: nine stages - topic discovery, research, script, voice, images, timeline, captions, assemble and edit, and QA. QA runs 11 auditors; a failed check triggers a self-healing retry that fixes and re-runs the stage; a pass produces a 1080x1920 MP4 that is scheduled via Buffer.
svg.text: archival photos per beat, pHash dedupe
cuts each photo to the word that names it
